name: Koga Mikado
source:
Akizuki High School, 2nd year student. 
With his excellent grades, perfect reflexes and sweet personality he is popular with all the girls in school.
He was known as a genius athlete in middle school, but for some reason he isn't a member of any clubs anymore.
He has the superpower "Electron" which he can use to freely control electricity.
